Get ACB Match List

Source: R/acb.R
acb_matchlist.Rd

The games of the round (or week) around a game.

One row per game. home_wins / home_losses / away_wins / away_losses are the teams' series record in a playoff series (null otherwise). match_grouping is round or week. team_id columns are season-team entries; club_id is stable.

Endpoint: GET https://api2.acb.com/api/matchdata/Menu/matchlist

Usage

acb_matchlist(match_id, round_id = NULL, week_id = NULL)

Arguments

match_id

(required) ACB match id (integer), one global sequence for every competition: legacy ids (seasons up to 2019-20) sit below about 20000 (12559 = the 2005-06 final); ids from 2020-21 start around 100000 (105401 = Barca 89-86 Valencia Basket, Liga 2026-27 round 3). A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

round_id

(default NULL) Round id (integer): global across seasons, not the round number (6017 = Liga 2026-27 round 3). List them with acb_competition_rounds or acb_calendar. Omitted = the current (or last) round. A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

week_id

(default NULL) Week id (integer): global across seasons (2989 = the week of 2026-10-10). List them with acb_competition_weeks. A whole number; a whole double is accepted.

Value

A hoopR_data tibble, one row per record described above; the columns are always these, in this order (sportsdataverse-py acb_matchlist):

col_nametypedescription
match_idintegerMatch id. Legacy ids (seasons up to 2019-20) sit below about 20000 (12559 = 2005-06 final, 17718 = 2016-17 final); from 2020-21 they start at about 100000 (102920 in 2021-22, 105401 in 2026-27). One key space across competitions: the matchId param of every matchdata route.
round_typecharacterPhase code: LR = Liga Regular (regular season), PO = playoffs (a bundle value, not in the samples); null on every row of /Menu/competition-data and /TeamProfile/next-matches
round_idintegerRound id: global across seasons, not the round number (6017 = Liga 2026-27 round 3; 2600 = 2016-17 round 1)
round_numberintegerRound number within the phase
group_idintegerGroup id in group-stage competitions
subphase_idintegerSub-phase id inside a phase (a playoff round or a cup round, e.g. 291, 292, 293); null in the regular season
subphase_numberintegerSub-phase number
week_idintegerWeek id: global across seasons (2989 = the week of 2026-10-10)
statuscharacterMatch state (x-match-statuses)
is_on_half_timelogicalAt half time (live)
current_quarterintegerCurrent or last quarter (0 before the match and in some finished rows)
home_scoreintegerHome points (null before the match)
away_scoreintegerAway points (null before the match)
startPOSIXctTip-off, ISO 8601 UTC
home_winsintegerHome team's series wins before the game (playoff series only).
home_lossesintegerHome team's series losses before the game (playoff series only).
away_winsintegerAway team's series wins before the game (playoff series only).
away_lossesintegerAway team's series losses before the game (playoff series only).
home_team_idintegerSeason-team id: one team's entry in one competition edition (4467 = Barca in Liga 2026-27, 4388 = Real Madrid in Liga 2025-26). Changes every season and competition. Joins every homeTeamId / awayTeamId / teamId / teamEditionId. Not the club id.
home_club_idintegerClub id, stable across seasons and sponsor names (2 = Barca, 9 = Real Madrid, 13 = Valencia Basket): the clubId request param and every homeClubId / awayClubId.
home_teamcharacterTeam name that season (sponsor names change)
home_team_abbrcharacterThree-letter abbreviation (BAR, RMB)
away_team_idintegerSeason-team id: one team's entry in one competition edition (4467 = Barca in Liga 2026-27, 4388 = Real Madrid in Liga 2025-26). Changes every season and competition. Joins every homeTeamId / awayTeamId / teamId / teamEditionId. Not the club id.
away_club_idintegerClub id, stable across seasons and sponsor names (2 = Barca, 9 = Real Madrid, 13 = Valencia Basket): the clubId request param and every homeClubId / awayClubId.
away_teamcharacterTeam name that season (sponsor names change)
away_team_abbrcharacterThree-letter abbreviation (BAR, RMB)
competition_idintegerCompetition id: 1 Liga Endesa, 2 Copa del Rey, 3 Supercopa Endesa, 10 Minicopa Endesa (x-competitions)
edition_idintegerSeason id (editionId) = season START year - 1935 (91 = 2026-27, 81 = 2016-17, 70 = 2005-06, 48 = 1983-84, the first). The sdv season (END year) is editionId + 1936. Season lists also carry seasonStartYear / seasonEndYear
seasonintegerSeason END year (2027 = 2026-27) = edition_id + 1936: the key the wrappers take.
is_selected_locallogicalNull in this list (set only in a club's game list).
match_groupingcharacterHow the list was grouped: round or week.

Details

Source, terms of use, request pacing, seasons, ids, coverage and error classes of this family: see the notes in acb_match_header().
